text: Okay, like I literally just told you. No, that doesn't work for me either. I can't give out my name and zip code over the phone like this. That's not what I asked. This whole process is just taking too long. Can I just talk to someone who can actually fix this?
zh: 好的，我刚才刚跟你说过了。不行，那对我也不行。我无法像这样在电话里提供我的姓名和邮编。那不是我问的。整个过程就是太慢了。我能跟一个能真正解决这个问题的客服人员说话吗？
